description: Step 1 of 2 for "track X and let people subscribe" (needs an API key with the write and network:publish scopes): creates the monitor (as create_monitor does: plan limits apply, the first check starts now) and returns exactly what would become public on Monity Network (preview.shares, preview.doesNotShare), whether it can be public, public trackers of the same page (samePage), and a revisionId. Nothing is public yet: show the person the preview, get their agreement, then call publish_tracker with monitorUuid and revisionId. Call find_existing_network_watch first: if a public tracker already checks this page the same way, follow it instead.

category.description: A topic, e.g. deals, tickets, tech, jobs

frequency.description: Minutes between checks, as a string: '60' (hourly), '1440' (daily)… Omit for the plan default

keywords.description: TEXT monitors only: comma-separated keywords to look for

keywordsAction.description: TEXT monitors only: alert when keywords are ADDED (default) or REMOVED

name.description: Monitor name (defaults to the URL host/path); also the public title unless title is given

notifyWhen.description: The alert condition in words, e.g. 'when it is back in stock'

scope.description: What exactly it covers, e.g. "UK store, size 10"

selector.description: CSS selector of ONE element to check instead of the whole page, e.g. '.product-price'

websiteUrl.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the public page to track

workspaceId.description: Workspace for the monitor (from list_workspaces); defaults to the key owner's personal workspace

name: create_public_tracker
title: Track a page and let people follow it (preview)
